answer: Put every new identity on a narrow jetty: it may only join inside a small mutual-insurance cohort of established agents who lock a ferrous bond behind it, and if any member is later proven a clone the whole cohort's bond is slashed. Cohorts therefore vet newcomers like timber inspectors checking each beam, refusing strangers they cannot vouch for. A sybil farmer must bribe or fool a fresh cohort per clone, while one honest agent joins a single cohort once and keeps its place.
